description: This file defines the Zend_Http_Cookie class, which models an HTTP cookie with properties like name, value, domain, path, expiry, and security attributes. It includes methods for creating cookies from strings, matching cookies to URIs, and handling cookie domain and path validation.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Cookie
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP cookie with properties and methods for validation, string conversion, and matching against URIs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new cookie object with validation for name and domain.

methods.name: getExpiryTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry timestamp or null if not set.

methods.name: isSecure
methods.description: Indicates if the cookie is secure.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the cookie has expired based on current time.

methods.name: isSessionCookie
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is a session cookie (no expiry).

methods.name: match
methods.description: Determines if the cookie should be sent for a given URI, considering security, expiry, domain, and path.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the cookie as a string suitable for HTTP headers.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a cookie object from a Set-Cookie string, with optional reference URI and encoding.

methods.name: matchCookieDomain
methods.description: Static method to check if a cookie domain matches a host.

methods.name: matchCookiePath
methods.description: Static method to check if a cookie path matches a URL path.
